title: Connecting Your ERP for Beige Account: API Integration Guide
summary: This API Integration Guide explains how to connect an ERP to a “Beige Account,” including required prerequisites (18 supported platforms or a custom plan), credential setup, connector/module configuration, account/entity selection, and chart of accounts/vendor master mapping. It specifies real-time balance behavior, a synchronization cadence constraint of $100,000, read-only and limited end-to-end testing steps, monthly call consumption monitoring, and ongoing maintenance (credential rotation, error-log monitoring, and version control).
faqs: Which ERP platforms are supported for connecting a Beige Account, and what should we do if ours isn’t in the list?
What service credentials should we provision, and how should they be permissioned for least-privilege access?
What are the exact steps to configure the banking connector/custom integration module and authorize access for syncing?
How should we map the ERP chart of accounts and vendor master data to bank account identifiers for reconciliation?
Does the integration update balances in real time, and how should downstream posting/reconciliation handle it?
What testing, monthly call limit monitoring, and maintenance steps (credential rotation, error logs, version control) does the guide require?
